about_the_game:
Game Overview

Training × Harem × Board Game Madness!
Conquer all 18 layers of hell and seduce every demoness commander you meet!

Light Roguelite × Zero Frustration — Grow stronger with every run. Permanent upgrades, stable progress, and no jail time.

Luck Is Power!
Roll the dice each turn to trigger random events and unexpected challenges.

100% Equipment Drop Rate!
Get stronger and get laid—on schedule, every time.

10+ Hellish Waifus to Interact With
Each with unique stories and spicy H scenes.

Harem-Flavored Pure Love Plot
No NTR. No futa. No “violating her mom” (probably)

Story Background

You are Ioliane, a decadent demon noble ruling a remote corner of Hell. Through your... “charisma”, you've created a land both orderly and depraved.

One day, your trusty aide Juliet finds a runaway girl—none other than Flora, the Demon King’s daughter, fleeing a political marriage.

With quick (and horny) thinking, you vow to escort her across the 18 layers of Hell—not just to return her, but to propose to the Demon King!

And so begins a scandalously sexy journey featuring:

  • A demon noble

  • A runaway princess

  • A tsundere aide

  • And a seductive succubus medic

    Gameplay

    Hell’s trials are tight and crowded—you can only bring one waifu with you per level.
    Choose from three companions before each stage, each with unique support skills:

    Juliet, the Aide: Reduces skill cooldowns for flexible strategies

    Flora, the Princess: Boosts HP and ensures steady growth

    Yuyu, the Medic: Provides consistent healing for stable endurance

    The roguelite plays out like a lewd board game:
    Roll two dice every turn—

    Movement Die (Ioliane): Decides how far and where you move

    Effect Die (Waifu): Grants combat buffs or support... or maybe a minor “accident”

    Every level includes:

    Fighting mobs for gear and upgrade materials
    Events and Shops to shape your growth path
    Resource planning based on the map layout
    Boss battles and spicy cutscenes after clearing zones

Game Features

Story-first design: Linear progression, no need to replay endlessly. Every waifu has her own exclusive story arc.

Progress that matters:

  • Permanent upgrades between runs

  • In-run gear & skill scaling for fast powerups

Pixel Art × Full-color H Comics:
Battle and exploration in charming pixel style; erotic scenes delivered in lush, full-color manga panels.

Humor × Lewdness:
Cheeky dialogues, spicy interactions—Hell’s never been so fun and sexy.

Harem Pleasures × Pure Love Endings:
Satisfy both your flesh and heart. Harem grows, bonds deepen, and love wins (with plenty of banging along the way).

One-Hand-Friendly Board Game System:
Roll, move, trigger events. Easy controls, chill lewd roguelite experience.

content_descriptors.notes: The characters appearing in this game are all adults aged 20 or over.
